expected_behavior: Prior turns prepended; in-flight excluded; history capped

name: Authenticated Cookie Capture Guard
user_story: As a user, I want Capture Session to save only real authenticated session
expected_behavior: Empty cookie snapshots remain with actionable message

name: Honest Detection Mode Labels
user_story: As a user, I want interface to distinguish DOM from AI detection
expected_behavior: Built-in names MiCoder; second names Auto Free

name: Web Agent Access-Level Gate
user_story: As a user, I want Ask before changes to protect web-agent mutations
expected_behavior: write/edit/todo/git/shell stop at Ask before changes

name: Visible Web Agent Approval Interruption
user_story: As a user, I want blocked mutation explained in chat
expected_behavior: Driver emits approvalRequired; presenter renders status

name: Named Session Origin-State Restoration
user_story: As a user, I want named web login to restore cookies and origin
expected_behavior: Login captures localStorage; restores on send

name: Custom Web Model Injection
user_story: As a user, I want custom web provider to confirm model
expected_behavior: customModelSelector used when no bundled catalog

name: Complete Destructive Tool Classification
user_story: As a user, I want every mutating tool classified

name: Single Explicit Version Bump
user_story: As a maintainer, I want one normal release bump
expected_behavior: build-app.sh updates CFBundle once per version

name: Project-Aware Shell Context
user_story: As a user, I want top shell to show active project context
expected_behavior: Workspace badge; session goal from project DB

name: Route-Specific Provider and Model Status
user_story: As a user, I want status bar to describe actual provider/model
expected_behavior: Connection state evaluated by selected route

name: Shell Actions and Endpoint Feedback
user_story: As a user, I want shell actions and endpoint labels explicit
expected_behavior: Only Serve routes show host:port; Cmd+Option+Z reports status
